constraints.definition: CHECK (((password_hash IS NOT NULL) OR ((role = 'MASTER'::text) AND (account_status = 'INVITED'::text))))

constraints.name: ex_work_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (master_id WITH =, slot WITH &&)

constraints.name: work_interval_master_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (master_id) REFERENCES beauty.master(master_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ck_start_grid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((EXTRACT(minute FROM start_at))::integer % 15) = 0) AND (EXTRACT(second FROM start_at) = (0)::numeric)))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_evidence
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'CONFIRMED'::text) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (cancellation_reason IS NULL) AND (result_marked_at IS NULL) AND (result_marked_by_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (result_marked_at IS NULL) AND (result_marked_by_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'NO_SHOW'::text])) AND (result_marked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (result_marked_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (cancellation_reason IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ex_appointment_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (master_id WITH =, slot WITH &&) WHERE ((status <> 'CANCELLED'::text))

constraints.name: appointment_client_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (client_user_id) REFERENCES beauty.user_account(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: moderation_decision_check1
